text: Marcus — did you catch the NEA announcement this morning? If the proposed cuts hold, we're looking at a real gap in the spring touring budget. Claire's already pulling numbers.
Just saw it. How much exposure are we talking? Is this the same cycle that covers the Austin and San Antonio dates?
Potentially $80k if the formula holds. SA is still soft anyway — this gives us one more reason to accelerate that decision before fall.
Understood. I'd rather know our board position now than let the news cycle turn it into a crisis narrative. Let me make some calls.
The Houston Chronicle already reached out for comment. Told them nothing until we have internal clarity. Worth a 15-min call Thursday?
Thursday works, before 10 if possible. I'm in back-to-back after that.
9am it is. Claire will send a one-pager beforehand so you're not walking in cold.
Good. And for what it's worth — the gala reserve is still untouched. The board won't leave Gulf Coast exposed on this.
Saw Karen posted about the Houston Arts gala — should we comment or just like it? Claire's already confirmed two comp tickets for us so feels weird to ignore it entirely.
Ryan — saw you liked Marcus's post about the Houston gala. That caption was a bit much, no? 🙄
Sophie, saw you replied to that NYT post about arts funding in regional cities — proud of you for speaking up. Half the board doesn't say that clearly. 🎭

Margaret, did you see Sylvia's post about the Houston arts gala? Claire and I were just laughing about the photo caption — someone really should've proofread that. You should drop a comment before it gets buried.
Liked Marcus's post about the gala write-up in the Chronicle — should I share it on the company page or does he want to handle the ballet's social himself?
Saw your comment on Marcus Jr.'s recital post — good instinct liking it, Houston arts parents notice that stuff. Builds goodwill with the donor families we need next season.
Tatiana — saw you liked Marcus's post about the NEA grant announcement. Left him a comment too, seemed like good news for the regional scene. Houston could use the momentum.
Saw you liked Marcus's post about the gala venue — good call, he was clearly pleased. Claire's already looped in on logistics so we're covered on the company side.
Daniela — saw your post from the Wortham shoot last night. Those curtain-call shots are something else. Claire's already asking if we can use one for the fall season mailer.
Maria — did you see Claire's post about the spring showcase? I left a reply but now I'm second-guessing the wording. Does 'quietly spectacular' land as a compliment or is that backhanded? 😅
